Keiser University is a private not-for-profit university with campuses throughout the state of Florida & online, including Fort Lauderdale, Clearwater, Daytona, Fort Myers, Jacksonville, Lakeland, Melbourne, Miami, Naples, New Port Richey, Orlando, Pembroke Pines, Port St. Lucie, Sarasota, Tallahassee, Tampa, and West Palm Beach. 

Visit KeiserUniversity.edu and follow us on social!

KeiserU is home of the Seahawks, our wide range of both Men's and Women's Athletic teams, including Baseball, Basketball, e-Sports, Football, Golf, Lacrosse, Soccer, Swimming, Tennis, Track & Field, Softball, Wrestling & Volleyball. 

At Keiser University, we are here to help you succeed by providing the professional and academic foundation to meet your educational goals and objectives. Keiser continues to be a valuable partner to employers, the community, and, above all, a valued choice for students serious about their education and career. 
#StudentsFirst
